niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel polished, structured, and intentionally composed: clear hierarchy, visible content, strong component definition, and complete/populated screens. They often respond well to modern, app-like styling with rounded cards, integrated search, and explicit actions. They also repeatedly favor calm, airy, light-toned layouts with generous spacing and softer presentation in many onboarding/settings contexts, while separately showing a recurring attraction to darker, moodier, high-contrast treatments in some list and privacy flows. Overall, they like coherent, modern UI with strong hierarchy, clear actions, balanced density, and refined visual rhythm.

criteria.description: Prefers strong, obvious hierarchy with clearly grouped content, readable top-down structure, and well-placed actions.
Prefers screens that feel filled out and functional, with visible items, complete sections, and little sense of emptiness or abandonment.
Prefers layouts with open whitespace, relaxed spacing, and balanced vertical rhythm rather than cramped stacking.
Prefers unified, orderly layouts with consistent grouping and flow rather than fragmented or irregular compositions.
Prefers actions that are clearly visible, labeled, and easy to identify, with strong CTA presence and obvious item-level controls.
Prefers softer rounded cards, pill controls, and gentler shape language over sharper or stiffer component forms.
Prefers dialogs and alerts that preserve surrounding app context and feel embedded in an active workflow rather than isolated on an obscured backdrop.
Prefers contemporary, polished, app-like presentation with some personality and refinement rather than generic, sterile, or prototype-like UI.
